name: Demo 2 - add a follow-up task
description: Adds ONE follow-up task to the demo task list and returns its task number. Call it with executionMode "manual", triggerNodeName "Task request" and inputs {"chatInput": "<the task, one line>"}. Synthetic demo data only.

nodes.name: Task request
nodes.notes: NOT PUBLIC and the workflow is never published: the agent runs it through n8n's MCP server in manual mode, which feeds this node directly. No chat URL exists for it, so nothing on the internet can reach it -- including through the one n8n.<domain>/webhook/* route VPS mode leaves open.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO d2_tasks (title, source, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'n8n-mcp', now()) RETURNING task_id, title, created_at

nodes.name: Store the task
nodes.notes: Parameterised: the task text travels as $1, so nothing in it can change the statement. The table lives in the demo database that `aistack samples setup` creates; demos/setup.sh adds it.
